name: Chou Mario
source:
Likes: Darkness, Risu
Dislikes: Thompson

Mario is a 20 year old creep who lives in the town junkyard. His favorite anime is Magical Girl Risu. 
Mario makes a living doing odd jobs for people in need of help. He’s a hero of justice in a world that doesn’t need one.

[From [url=http://eternalproject.tumblr.com/character] Tumblr[/url]]
